gates.evidence: The proposal targets deep reasoning mode on safe, SFW assistant surfaces.
Reward is earned via a 15-second mini-game play with no cash, gift cards, or click/install incentives.
Uses gain-oriented session pass copy ('Unlock Deep Reasoning Now') with standard opt-in buttons and no dark patterns.
Requires an explicit tap on the 'Play Now' CTA before any ad initiates.
Clearly states the action ('Play a quick 15-second game') and reward ('30 minutes of deep reasoning') prior to the ad.
Includes an equally legible 'No Thanks' decline option returning the user to the sheet without penalty.
Triggered when hitting the subscription wall on deep reasoning, not mid-stream during generation.
Explicitly restricted to non-paying guests and free users hitting the paywall.

scores.evidence: The proposal targets the exact moment of need when hitting the deep reasoning wall (m9), but the patch incorrectly models an entitlement plan (r1) as a numeric delta (delta: 1), capping the score at 2 per instruction rule 7.
Time-boxed session pass preserves user flow, provides native tasting of deep reasoning without permanent devaluing, and keeps the subscription upsell visible.
Gated strictly to non-payers hitting the paywall, time-boxed to 30 minutes, capped at 2 per day, and preserves the Luzia+ subscription upsell.
Cost to serve ($0.0090) exceeds net revenue per view ($0.0063) at the low end as flagged by code.
Hits users attempting to use deep reasoning mode (m9), representing a solid segment of engaged feature users.
Uses standard Simula SIM-RWD unit with button entry point and SSV verification.
References Luzia, deep reasoning, s07, and s27, but loses specificity credit for improperly treating the subscription plan entitlement as a numeric currency delta.
Explicit caps of 2 per day and 30-minute cooldowns, with no re-offer after decline.
Defines primary metric, guardrails (-3% subscription conversion, retention parity), and a 10% user-level randomized holdout over 28 days.

requiredChanges: Fix the patch resource grant to specify a proper time-boxed entitlement rather than granting numeric delta 1 of subscription plan r1.
Optimize COGS by routing session passes through a lighter model or adjusting duration/view requirements to ensure net positive margins per view.
parsed.topConcern: The patch incorrectly treats a subscription plan entitlement as a countable currency quantity (delta: 1), and inference COGS exceeds net revenue per view at the low end.
